Marc — thanks, good questions. Short answers below and a few notes on tradeoffs.

- Latency capability
  * Hosted (shared): typical p95 for user-facing gen is ~300–400ms for short prompts on standard regions; with our optimized routing we can often get into the low 300s.
  * Dedicated / VPC: with reserved GPU pools and tuned kernels we target p95 <= 250ms for comparable prompt sizes; this assumes a Dedicated cluster and pinning model variant.

- Cost / lead time
  * Hosted: lowest up-front cost, billed usage; no provisioning time.
  * Dedicated/VPC: higher fixed monthly commitment (we'll provide a range), provisioning lead time typically 7–14 business days once contract is signed and infra details are provided.

- SLA options
  * We can offer a 99.95% uptime SLA on Dedicated plans with an agreed credit structure. Latency SLOs are available as an addendum (we've done p95 commitments in prior deals with measurable credits).

- Security artifacts
  * We can share SOC2 summary, pen-test overview, and our data retention/audit log outline within 48 hours.

I'll attach a one-page performance vs cost snapshot and a short table of provisioning timelines for Dedicated. Laura will drop the MAP and draft SLA. Happy to run a short tech deep-dive demo with infra/ops folks if that helps procurement/legal.

Ben
